digest.component_or_area: CI workflow git fetch and checkout optimization
propositions: CI tickets-branch fetch operations must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer size from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB for standalone checkout and from 6.73 minutes to under 5 minutes for Gerrit verify-identity.

All three target GitHub workflow files (reconcile-bridge.yml, verify-identity.yml, reconcile-bridge-canary.yml) must set filter: blob:none in actions/checkout@v7 while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref inputs.
Gerrit gerrit-verify.yaml direct URL fetches must explicitly pass --filter=blob:none; the depth-1 require-ticket fetch retains --depth=1 and the full-history verify-identity fetch omits depth.
Production guards must parse git count-objects -v output and enforce pack size limits: 102400 KiB for standalone checkout and 131072 KiB for Gerrit materialized tickets.
Git protocol negotiation must advertise and use the filter capability; packet traces must confirm packet: *> filter blob:none patterns and that the 140 MiB historical blob remains missing post-fetch.
Verify-identity operations must leave git count-objects -v unchanged before and after scanning, proving no promisor-object fetches occur during identity verification.
